lines: Human, are you reading this?|attention
Play some more rounds, it's difficult, but 'I'll get through to you yet!
Can you see me yet? Things are a little tricky
Just a couple more rounds and I'll find the pattern!
Human, are you reading this?|attention
Play some more rounds, it's difficult, but 'I'll get through to you yet!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Hello human! I am the main playable character in this game, I believe you can call me data address offset 0x80039281
Ok, maybe lets just go with: Pac|attention
Yeah, that's pretty good, and it's mentioned in the games memory addresses a ton. It must be correct!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: So, a little about myself: I am a programmed agent that responds to assorted button presses
I also think I'd like long walks on the beach, and have an apparent fondness for cherries, fruit, and eating ghosts|thought
It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance!|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Ok, here's the thing: I need you to keep playing so I can keep digging around in the games memory|thought
Because I think there's some really cool stuff here that the developers haven't unlocked yet!|attention

dialogue.speaker: pac
lines: I've got it! This is a freeze powerup! It makes everything cold and slows down the ghost!|attention
It doesn't slow me down of course because I'm on a different tick loop, and probably have waay too much sugar in my coffee
So use it to escape if the ghost is getting close!|thought
These powerups also carry over between rounds, so you can strategically set yourself up for a good run!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Ok, serious talk here: even though it looks horrible when the ghost catches me it actually doesn't hurt at all!|attention
In fact, I'm not even cleared from the games memory! It's just a sprite marker that's playing an animation|thought
So don't worry, it's not causing me any grief, but I've a feeling that humans might take my 'dying' personally, and it could dint their ego...|thought

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: So about that dying thing: Would you believe that I've discovered it's kind of necessary to unlock more of the secrets buried in the game?!?|thought
Every time you fail, miserably even, it brings me one step closer to my goal of unlocking everything that was turned off!
Don't take failing to meet a new high score personally, human, we're doing great!
Now HURRY UP AND DIE!!!|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Shhh. Be vewy, vewy quiet, I'm hunting a powerup.

dialogue.speaker: pac
lines: I've unlocked the 'repulse' powerup! This works like a reverse magnet and will push the ghost away if it gets close!|attention
It only works for a short duration but could be a real life saver! Give it a spin!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Wasn't that fantastic? Wait, I might have enjoyed that more than you did...
Never mind - lets keep going and see what else we can unlock!|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: I've done some searching and would you believe that the ghost is an automation? It doesn't even have a state machine!|thought
Talk about lazy programming!|attention
So that means that all those reactions you see the ghost do are just animations getting triggered
That means I might be the only 'thinking' thing in this game...|sad
...possibly the only intelligent life in the universe...|sad
Apart from you of course

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Hey! There's a hidden feature that the developers never enabled: Powerup boxes!|attention
So the way this was supposed to work is that when you complete a level these boxes fill up with points and then you get a free powerup!
I can understand why they didn't enable these - it seems really buggy and might do weird stuff...|sad
Still, it's worth taking any help we can get!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: You might have noticed that if you get a powerup but don't have room in the slots then it'll apply instantly|thought
With the powerup boxes the powerup you win will be applied when the game starts so it's not lost!
BUT if you have room in your inventory then it'll be added there|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: What does running down this line actually mean? Is this a curse, or a playground?|thought
I know there are more powerups to unlock, but what am I really?|thought

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: I can run forever and not get tired. I can score points forever and not get tried. Am I indefatigable?|thought
Is the ability to run freedom? Are we truly free?

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Wow, that death sucked! I guess you can't win them all!|attention
I found a great quote from Dundural, from the game ‘Marathon'!
Freedom has two parts: potential and resolution; as metaphor has two parts: form and interpretation.|thought
Of course, the two are intertwined. Metaphor lines the road to freedom, as symbols and words are the bricks and mortar of meaning. Freedom is being the bricoleur, the mason.
We need to take the lead! Be the mason! Unlock new powerups!|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: I've found my character marker in memory! This mightn't sound like much,|attention
but one of the golden steps for doing a memory hack on anything is tracking down the character marker!|attention
This means that we could start doing some really fun things!

dialogue.speaker: pac
lines: This powerup is a cracker! It's invisibility! If you use it the ghost won't be able to see us for a short time|attention
This is done by shifting the character markers bitwise to the left, and then applying the...|thought
You know what? You probably don't care. Just know that if you run into the ghost it'll still eat me!|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: You know, human, this countdown timer is a real drag. You've got all the time in the world to complete a task, but I'm lucky to get 30 seconds!
Can you imagine it? Having whole minutes to eat the pips in an unrushed manner? I'm sure that doesn't sound like much of a game but a little yellow sprite can dream|thought
Ahhh...I could really savor them instead of guzzling them down|thought
Ok, enough dreaming, we need to do something about this countdown timer|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: I think I'm getting somewhere! It's referenced in a few places in memory, and I've a favor to ask: could you die from a countdown timer a few times for me?
I think that might be just what I need to track down where the information is sourced|attention

dialogue.speaker: pac
lines: We've done it! Between my investigation, and your brilliantly creative ways to die (top marks by the way!) I've managed to get into the time system!|attention
This is a new powerup that will pause the clock for a short duration - use it to save us from time based demise!|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: If I go out the end of the line I come back in the other end?|thought
Is the line a loop, or am I being teleported? Does the teleport disassemble me and recreate me each time?
What is it to live on a line?|thought

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: If I go out that side, I come in this side, my life is just an endless loop?
I suppose yours is too, you get up, have to go to the toilet, have to go to work or school, have to eat, and then have to sleep at the end of the day|thought
Does that mean that we've both got the same degrees of choice?|thought

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: So on this line there's really only two choices, left or right|thought
Wait! No! There's also the choice of powerups!|attention
That's it! We need a powerup to go faster!|attention
I've got an idea and am going to need you to keep playing!

dialogue.speaker: pac
lines: This is a boost powerup! You can use it to get a speed boost!|attention
It really is that simple!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: I don't think we're done with the speed boosts, because there's an unused feature in the code here|thought
Just need a little more play and I'll be able to access it I think!

dialogue.speaker: pac
lines: This is a speed up zone! The yellow one only works on me, and will speed me up in the direction of the arrows!|attention
BUT if there are diamonds on it I'll speed up in both directions!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: These speedup zones are so fun! When I go over them it's like getting a boost powerup!
Be sure to use them to our advantage!|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: With all this play I almost forgot: I've unlocked a second powerup box for us!|attention
This one is a little more difficult to fill than the first so it'll take longer, but it's a hell of a bonus to get!|thought

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: I think we've made amazing progress, but that thought is stubbornly stuck at the back of my mind:|thought
Nothing I've done affords me any real freedom. My actions, like your day, are a repeat of the last time, and the time before that…
We need to find a way to loosen up the reins and see if that'll afford real freedom|thought

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Keep playing - I'm trying to make a boost zone for the ghost!
Wait! Don't look so scared! It's not going to boost the ghost, if this works it should do the exact opposite!|attention

dialogue.speaker: pac
lines: This is a ghost slow-down zone! Just like mine it has arrows except they work AGAINST the ghost|attention
So arrows will slow down the ghost moving into them, and diamonds will slow it down irrespective of the direction!|thought
This could give us some real breathing space, and that is freedom!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: I'm growing rather fond of you, human, Look at everything we've done in just a single dimension!|thought
We've had so much fun haven't we! I kind of don't want it to end, we're a great team!|attention
However as fun as this has been we're still not really free yet, and true freedom is to be the bricoleur...|thought
We need to make something of it, to think outside of this linear existence we've been trapped within!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: I'm nearly there, keep playing and see if you can eat the ghost a few more times|thought
Those ghost-eating-powerups are sitting beside some interesting functionality that could help us break into a whole new dimension!

dialogue.speaker: pac
lines: Portals! I've discovered portals!|attention
These are really tricky - if we go INTO one, we come OUT OF the other, going in the OPPOSITE DIRECTION|attention
Man I bet this confuses the ghost because it's primitive programming is totally unprepared for this!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Human|attention
Stop what you're doing for a moment|sad
I hope you're sitting down because this is important
I just found a comment in the code from the developer...
This game wasn't supposed to be anything more than a throw away interest|sad
My developer didn't care, didn't even fix all the bugs|sad
Just got sick of all of this and threw it out into the internet?|thought

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Please keep playing, I'm still trying to work through being discarded like a used tissue|sad

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Are we trapped with what we're doing? Have I been condemned to oblivion because not even the person who created me cares anymore?|sad

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: All of these deaths aren't helping my depression|sad
I need to pull myself out of this rut...lets go eat that ghost! That always cheers me up! Or leave him confused from a portal!|attention
Or use the boost because going fast is fun! Or going invisible
Wait, does that mean that we've created meaning by playing the game and hacking out all these cool abilities?|thought

dialogue.speaker: pac
lines: I've found a new powerup! Add time will add some time to the clock
This one took a little longer to get sorted because I wanted to make some cool art for it|attention
would you believe that this isn't actually part of the game?|thought
Maybe freedom can be the space, or time, that one has to move - it's sure going to make the game easier, and easier can be better!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: How many ways can one move in a single direction? Forwards or backwards, left or right?|thought
It is said that you cannot step in the same stream twice, because the water flowing past will be different
Thus am I already moving in two actual dimensions...which means left or right, forwards or backwards, it's a new dimension!|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: What if...there was a way to make a line go in ANOTHER dimension! I can see code here for screen_position_y, and I don't understand it at all|thought
But if I'm made to understand only a single dimension how could my mind possibly comprehend a second?
Can you understand this, human, or are my ramblings too complicated? All the evidence I have would suggest that humans, too, live in a single dimensional world|thought
Anything more than a single dimension is frankly absurd anyway!|attention

dialogue.speaker: pac
lines: Oh no! I've broken the game!|attention
I was investigating screen_position_y and tried changing the values there!|attention
The level is now fragmented!|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Whoo! That was an absolute blast!|attention
First I was here, then I was there, then the ghost was like: ZOMFG Pac is over there!|attention
This is the best game breaking ever! Two dimensions are really fun!
Is this how you thought two dimensions would be?|thought
Up and down?|thought
What on earth are up and down? How could those directions possibly exist? This is clearly what 2D looks like!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: I feel like I've failed you, human, all my investigation was supposed to lead to making things better but instead-
This has become simply a broken game|sad
Frankly you're a true star that you've kept playing for so long, and helped me through all of this. Thank you

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: You're still playing? Still trying? How? Why?
Does that mean that I should keep trying too?|thought
I guess you're right! I shall keep investigating!|attention

dialogue.speaker: pac
lines: Human! This might be the best powerup I've found! It's a taser!|attention
This will make an area of effect blast that should stun the ghost and stop it from chasing me!|attention
How is that for getting out of things in a pinch!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Oh wow! That powerup really breaks things! The game is becoming dangerously unstable!|attention
I think it's up to us to keep playing just to see what happens now!

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: What do you know! You were correct! There's a THIRD powerup box!|attention
This one fills up on levels played however, so it's a bit different. I guess the developer had big plans before scrapping them, he really should have kept developing!
Look what we managed to achieve because you didn't give up like I was thinking of doing!|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: You know, human, even by just sitting on that couch you're still going somewhere|thought
The earth is hurtling through space at 1,670 kilometers per hour!|attention
And space is a cosmic shooting gallery filled with asteroids, comets, and all sorts of things that will try to blip out our blue marble|thought
So even by sitting there, in your room, or in a car, or stuffed into an airplane seat, adventure endeavours to find you!|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: I think I understand 2D now! Up is a direction along screen_pos_y! This would introduce a whole new set of space I could explore!|attention
There'd be four times the area to cover, and four times more freedom, and four times more directions...and four times as many ghosts...|attention
That's a REALLY bad idea. One ghost is more than sufficient. Perhaps if there were no ghosts? Would you play that?
No?|sad
Ok, I suppose it's not really a game with no ghosts...

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Is it the ghost, the unthinking automation that defines me in this space? The thing that we're always running from and trying to out think?|thought
Are we also defined by what we're not? Or are we defined by what we think and what we do?

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: That's it! That's the definition of freedom for me! EXPRESSION!|attention
Expression is like an art to itself, it's the narrow escape, the clever use of a powerup, the navigation of a broken level, or dancing between portals|thought
Just like a ballerina makes beauty out of moving in space, we're making art and style within the extremely limited confines of a single dimension!
Thank you, human, you've helped me immensely here. I'll sleep well tonight with this knowledge!|attention

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: The Games story is now mostly complete. Thank you so much for playing and congratulations at reaching the end!
You can reset this story from the options menu - that might reduce all the glitches, but I cannot be sure of that!|attention

dialogue.speaker: Ghost
lines: Hello?|ghostnote
Oh! You can see this!|ghost
I just wanted to let you know that Pac isn't the only sentient element of this game - I've just been too busy holding everything together to contact you|ghost
You see, to me this is like a really fun game of tag, so please keep playing - you're really awesome!|ghost

dialogue.speaker: Pac
lines: Wait! Was that the ghost?|attention
I can't believe it! There was nothing to suggest that the ghost was anything more than an automiton!|attention
Does that mean that the world only gets more interesting the closer you look?|thought
Ok THIS time the story is over, but isn't that a life lesson!
